DIVING at a target — the dragon folds its wings and plunges nose-down, the rider flattened low against its neck, wind screaming, ground rushing up.
BANKING THROUGH A CANYON — the dragon tilts hard, one wing-tip grazing near the rock wall, the rider leaning deep into the turn, tail streaming behind.
CLIMBING INTO STORM-CLOUDS — the dragon beats massive wings upward, body nearly vertical, the rider pressed back hard into the saddle, lightning flickering above them.
BREATHING FIRE MID-FLIGHT — the dragon's jaws blast a torrent of flame across the sky as the rider shields their face and grips the neck ridge.
CHARGING INTO AN AERIAL BATTLE — the dragon surges forward at full wingbeat, head lowered, the rider raising a lance and leaning far over the shoulder.
BURSTING UP THROUGH CLOUD — the dragon punches through the cloud ceiling in an eruption of mist, wings fully spread wide, the rider whooping with arms briefly raised.
SKIMMING LOW OVER A BATTLEFIELD — the dragon streaks just above the chaos, wings near-flat, belly almost brushing smoke, the rider scanning below with bow drawn and ready.
LOOSING AN ARROW MID-DIVE — the dragon angles sharply downward, wings tucked half-closed, the rider twisting sideways in the saddle and releasing the bowstring at the target.
REARING TO A HOVER BEFORE A FOE — the dragon beats wings furiously to hold position, body upright, claws extended, the rider meeting the enemy's gaze with sword leveled.
CLAWING AT A RIVAL MID-AIR — the dragon slashes talons across a foe's flank, wings beating hard for balance, the rider gripping tight as the whole body lurches.
TAKING OFF FROM A CLIFF — the dragon launches from the ledge in a single explosive lunge, wings snapping open wide, the rider thrown back as they drop then rise.
WEAVING THROUGH ARROW-FIRE — the dragon rolls and jinks left then right, wings folding and flaring in rapid bursts, the rider pressed flat, arrows hissing past them.
TRIUMPHANT CLIMB AT DAWN — the dragon spirals upward through golden light, wings fully spread and glowing, the rider sitting tall with arms wide and face lifted skyward.
ROLLING INVERTED AT SPEED — the dragon barrel-rolls completely over, wings slicing the air through the full rotation, the rider clenched hard in the harness, horizon spinning wildly.
STALLING INTO A WINGOVER — the dragon halts its climb at the apex, hangs a moment, then pivots sharply over the wing, the rider swinging with the turn.
STOOPING ON PREY FROM HEIGHT — the dragon tucks wings to its body and drops like a stone in a true falcon-stoop, the rider pressed utterly flat and breathless.
SLAMMING INTO AN ENEMY FLYER — the dragon collides chest-first with a rival beast, wings flaring for impact, the rider bracing both arms and roaring the command to strike.
CLIMBING VERTICALLY IN A HAMMERHEAD — the dragon powers straight up until momentum dies, pivots hard on a wingtip, and drives back down, the rider wrenched sideways then forward.
THREADING BETWEEN TWO TOWERS — the dragon tilts on edge to fit the gap, one wing high and one wing low, the rider ducking close as stone rushes past.
RETREATING AT FULL SPRINT — the dragon pounds wings in huge desperate strokes and flees low across treetops, the rider looking back over one shoulder, urging greater speed.
GLIDING SILENTLY ABOVE FOG — the dragon spreads still wings and drifts ghost-quiet over a thick fog bank, the rider crouching motionless, watching for shapes rising below.
SNATCHING A SOLDIER FROM A TOWER — the dragon swoops in a tight arcing pass, one foreclaw reaching out, the rider pointing the target out and ducking behind the neck.
BREAKING LEFT IN A SCISSORS TURN — the dragon cuts hard left mid-duel, wings snapping asymmetrically, body twisting to get behind the pursuer, the rider pulling on the guide rein.
DESCENDING IN A TIGHT SPIRAL — the dragon corkscrews downward around a column of air, wings angled and constant, the rider leaning with each revolution, eyes fixed on the landing below.
PLUNGING THROUGH A BURNING SAIL — the dragon punches through fire and canvas at full speed, wings folded tight, the rider shielding their eyes as flame and shredded cloth erupt past.
